metadata.article_title: One domicile only affects succession to moveables.

article.title: One domicile only affects succession to moveables.
article.content: A person can have only one domicile for the purpose of the succession to his moveable property.
article.html:
6One domicile only affects succession to moveables.

Section 6 · Part II · page 18 of the Act

A person can have only one domicile for the purpose of the succession to his moveable property.
